title: Sheep and Goats
summary: Sheep and goats were common parts of pastoral life, providing food, wool, milk, skins, and sacrificial animals.
background: Scripture uses flock imagery for guidance, vulnerability, separation, sacrifice, and judgment. These images often draw from ordinary rural experience.
teachingHelp: Help listeners see how familiar daily-life images became powerful spiritual teaching tools in Scripture.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
